theater: 斯雷代茨與巴爾干山道

battle.name: 拜占庭征服保加利亞
battle.theater: 斯雷代茨與巴爾干山道
battle.brief: 公元968年，拜占庭皇帝尼基弗魯斯二世在沙皇彼得一世決裂後遠征，八月在斯雷代茨外遭伏擊全軍覆沒；969年御駕再攻卡在山道。齊米斯基斯接位後於970年8月27日在斯雷代茨城下大破保軍，971年迫沙皇薩穆伊爾投降，保加利亞降為軍區。卡面秦弩早於本役千餘年，壓制城頭的是希臘火與投石機。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 這場戰爭是拜占庭帝國與保加利亞第一帝國在巴爾干半島的一場總體決戰，時間橫跨公元968至971年，交戰雙方都把對方視為不可容忍的對手。拜占庭一方是君士坦丁堡的中央政權：皇帝尼基弗魯斯二世·福卡斯統轄下的軍區制國家，兵源包括常備的帳籍軍與愛琴海、色雷斯一帶的徵召兵，同時大量僱用北方來客——瓦良格人、匈牙利弓手與鄰近斯拉夫部族的戰士，這批北來傭兵是拜占庭野戰隊的骨幹。拜占庭內部有兩派爭權：掌軍的庫爾庫阿斯系與接位的福卡斯系，968年大將約翰·庫爾庫阿斯病逝後，兵權與宮廷黨爭都集中在福卡斯一家手中，前線指揮則在福卡斯兄弟與出身禁軍的將領之間輪替。保加利亞一方是控制從亞得里亞海東岸直到黑海西岸、以普雷斯拉夫與斯雷代茨為雙都的沙皇國家：沙皇彼得一世時代全國被劃成若干軍區，貴族以「布拉奇」等名號率領自備的重騎與步兵，「斯特拉斯特」則是從軍區抽調的輕裝襲擊分隊。第三方並非局外人：拜占庭向北購買瓦良格與匈牙利兵員，保加利亞同樣從基輔與諾曼方向取得傭兵與流亡者；匈牙利大公居魯姆依拜占庭之命改宗並與帝國結盟攻保；東地中海的阿拉伯政權則趁帝國空虛在安納托利亞與敘利亞方向牽制兵力，東西方兩條戰線同時拉緊。
countriesEn: This war was a general decision between the Byzantine Empire and the First Bulgarian Empire in the Balkans, fought across the years 968 to 971, and each side regarded the other as intolerable. The Byzantine side was the central government of Constantinople: a state organised into themes under Emperor Nikephoros II Phokas, drawing its men from the standing tagmata, from levies of the Aegean and Thracian provinces, and above all from northern hire — Varangians, Hungarian archers and warriors drawn from the neighbouring Slav peoples, who formed the backbone of the Byzantine field army. Two factions contested power inside Byzantium, the Kourkouas party and the Phokas party; when the great general John Kourkouas died in 968, military authority and the struggle over the palace both settled into the hands of the Phokas, and command in the field rotated between the Phokas brothers and generals who came out of the palace regiments. The Bulgarian side was the tsar's state, which stretched from the eastern Adriatic to the western Black Sea and kept twin capitals at Preslav and Sredets: under Tsar Peter I the country was divided into military districts, the nobles brought their own heavy cavalry and infantry under titles such as the brachii, and the strasti were light raiding detachments drawn out of those districts. Third parties were not bystanders: Byzantium bought Varangians and Hungarians in the north, and Bulgaria drew its own mercenaries and refugees from the same direction, from Kiev and from the Norman lands; the Hungarian duke Gyula was converted with Byzantine help and turned into an ally against Bulgaria; and the Arab caliphate on the eastern Mediterranean pulled at Byzantine strength in Anatolia and Syria at the same time, so that two fronts were drawn tight simultaneously.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的拜占庭人物橫跨三代皇帝。公元968年發動遠征時在位的是尼基弗魯斯二世·福卡斯，他本人以精於兵事著稱，但真正把大軍交到前線的是他的弟弟尼基弗魯斯與表弟巴爾達斯·福卡斯；巴爾達斯娶了庫爾庫阿斯之女，此前已在邊境打了十多年，被拜占庭人稱為「保加利亞人的屠殺者」。首戰覆滅後皇帝御駕親征，卻在山道被保加利亞輕騎困住，於是內心的矛盾與宿疾一併爆發，公元969年12月11日病逝於君士坦丁堡；12月16日，排行第六的弟弟約翰·齊米斯基斯在禁軍與元老院的推戴下即位。他的母親出身保加爾王族，他的妻子則是馬其頓的貴族婦女，這位將領第一次把拜占庭的帝國戰爭從家族私鬥轉成了國策。齊米斯基斯身邊的關鍵人物還有掌璽的西菲亞斯、掌管禁軍的帕拉科伊梅諾斯巴西爾·萊卡佩諾斯，以及奉命與薩穆伊爾談判的狄奧多西·多切特斯，這位使節的說服力使保加利亞不戰而降。保加利亞方面，開戰時的沙皇是彼得一世，實權逐步落到他的兄弟薩穆伊爾手中——薩穆伊爾在968年之前以總督身分坐鎮普雷斯拉夫，直到那一年的戰敗之後才正式登基稱帝；他的弟弟弗拉基米爾與婿克拉圖斯分別統率保軍右翼與別爾格拉德守軍，971年在戰場上被俘並被弄瞎雙眼。留下戰爭記錄的拜占庭史家狄奧菲拉托斯·西莫卡塔與利奧·狄亞科尼，前者是事件的直接記述者，後者的《皇帝史》提供了戰場細節，是今日重建這幾場會戰的主要依據。
peopleEn: The Byzantine figures who decided the course of this war span three emperors. When the expedition was launched in 968 the emperor was Nikephoros II Phokas, himself celebrated for his knowledge of war, but the great army was actually handed to the front by his brother Nikephoros and his cousin Bardas Phokas; Bardas had married Kourkouas's daughter and had spent more than a decade on the frontier, and the Byzantines called him the slayer of Bulgarians. After the first army was destroyed the emperor campaigned in person, was trapped in a mountain defile by Bulgarian light cavalry, and then saw the contradictions of his own position and his chronic illness break out together: he died at Constantinople on 11 December 969. On 16 December his sixth brother, John Tzimiskes, was acclaimed by the palace regiments and the senate. His mother was of Bulgarian royal blood and his wife a Macedonian noblewoman, and this general was the first to turn the imperial war of Byzantium from a family quarrel into a policy of state. The other key figures around Tzimiskes were the master of the chancery, Xiphias, the parakoimomenos Basil Lekapenos who commanded the palace guard, and Theodore Docetes, the emissary sent to negotiate with Samuel; the persuasiveness of that envoy was what brought Bulgaria to terms without another battle. On the Bulgarian side the tsar at the outbreak was Peter I, while real power passed gradually to his brother Samuel — Samuel had governed Preslav as a provincial commander until the defeat of that year and was raised to the imperial title only afterwards. Samuel's brother Vladimir and his son-in-law Cratus commanded the right wing of the Bulgarian host and the garrison of Bergrad respectively, and both were taken in the field in 971 and had their eyes put out. The Byzantine historians who left the record, Theophylact Simocatta and Leo the Deacon, were both writing for the victors' capital: the first is the direct narrator of the events, and the second, in his History of the Emperors, supplies the detail of the fighting and is the main basis on which these battles can be reconstructed today.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩屬戰國末至秦漢的工藝：銅質弩機裝在木臂之後，扳機連桿把弦的拉力存住，射手不必像拉弓那樣在每一次射擊中耗盡臂力，裝填與擊發因此可以分開，射速遠勝於弓；更進者還有自弩機構，弩匣裡備好矢，等於把一次一發變成連發數十。這件兵器與保加利亞戰爭相隔一千兩百年，不可能出現在斯雷代茨城下的戰場上；真正走過這條路的是同一族的技術：弩機自中國北方草原向西傳入羅馬世界的巴利斯塔弩砲、薩珊的射手型弩，再經伊斯蘭世界進入拜占庭，稱為托雷斯與手提弩弓，約西元九一二年至九五九年間的《烏斯賓斯基戰術》即記載近衛軍以多射弩守衛君士坦丁堡城牆。本役真正決定城頭與隘口勝負的是別的東西：拜占庭以希臘火（銅管手提虹吸與舟車上的大瓶）配合投石機與木製攻城塔對付保加利亞的土築堡壘，用配重投石機砸擊城牆與城頭建築；步兵主力是持大圓盾與斧的斯科塔托伊式重裝兵，翼側是穿鎖子甲、配長槍的卡塔夫拉克特重騎，核心是瓦良格近衛與禁軍的重裝步兵；弓兵用小型反曲弓覆蓋城頭，標槍手在陣前投射，保加利亞一方則以弓手、標槍與大小盾牌的步兵擋住隘口，輕騎靠地形切斷對手的縱隊，並以堡壘、壕溝與樹林拖住攻方。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card belongs to the craft of the late Warring States and the Qin-Han: a bronze lock mechanism set behind a wooden stock, where the trigger linkage stores the strain of the string, so that the archer need not spend his whole strength on every shot and loading can be separated from loosing, which gives a rate of fire far beyond that of the bow; more advanced forms had a self-cocking mechanism with a magazine of bolts already in the case, turning a single shot into a burst of dozens. This weapon stands more than twelve centuries away from the Bulgarian war and could not have been on the field below the walls of Sredets; what actually travelled the road was the same family of technology. The lock went west from the northern steppes of China into the Roman world as the ballista and the shooting crossbow of the Sasanians, and then through the Islamic world into Byzantium, where it was called the toreus and the hand crossbow; the Tactikon of Uspensky, compiled between about 912 and 959, records the imperial guard defending the walls of Constantinople with the multi-shot crossbow, the polystoron. The things that actually decided the walls and the passes in this campaign were different: Byzantium used Greek fire, in the form of bronze hand-siphons and the large flasks carried on carts, together with stone-throwers and timber siege towers against the earthen fortresses of Bulgaria, and used counterweight traction engines to pound the ramparts and the buildings on the wall; the infantry core was heavy troops of the skoutatoi type with large round shields and axes, the flanks were cataphract heavy cavalry in mail carrying long lances, and the centre was the Varangian guard and the heavy infantry of the palace regiments; light archers with small recurve bows covered the walls and javelin men threw from the front of the line. On the Bulgarian side, infantry armed with bows, javelins and shields of every size held the passes, light cavalry cut the enemy's columns by taking advantage of the ground, and the defence of the campaign was made with fortresses, ditches and woodland used to slow the attacker down.
tactics: 拜占庭這三代將領的戰術，對照了帝國在巴爾干的攻守轉換。968年的遠征是典型的拜占庭縱隊攻勢：重步兵居中，騎兵分列兩翼，弓手與投石機隨軍前推，糧秣車隊與援軍拖在後方，隊形一入隘道就拉成數里的長蛇，結果在斯雷代茨以東被保加利亞的斯特拉斯特以縱隊偷襲切斷，落到隘口的只有主力的前段。969年尼基弗魯斯二世仍用密集步兵正面硬頂的辦法，卻在山道被焚草斷糧、遭騎兵反覆襲擾，終於折回。真正的轉折是齊米斯基斯：他從阿拉伯人與保加爾人身上學來的做法，是把輕裝散兵與弓手放在大軍之前作前哨，一段一段消耗敵軍的銳氣，主力重裝步兵沉著不動，騎兵只在兩翼與敵軍側後出現，等對方在強攻中拉散陣形才讓近衛一波壓上；史料記載他在斯雷代茨城下正是用這種節奏贏的，一戰之後保加利亞在南部平原再沒有可用的野戰主力。保加利亞一方的戰術是守險待援：多瑙河與斯雷代茨之間的地形是他們的盾，窄隘、深谷與鐵門一類的關口讓拜占庭的縱隊自毀；968年設伏於隘中、969年焚燒草場斷敵馬料、970年在克萊迪翁以輕兵截擊拜占庭的分遣隊，都是同一套辦法。971年薩穆伊爾不肯再打野戰，退守比托拉附近的維特堡壘，以木柵與投石封住進攻道路，是把戰爭拖成圍城的最後手段。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the three Byzantine commanders map the shift in the empire's posture in the Balkans. The expedition of 968 was the classic Byzantine column attack: heavy infantry in the centre, cavalry on the wings, archers and stone-throwers pushing forward with the army, the baggage train and the reinforcements trailing behind; once the column entered a defile it stretched into a snake several miles long, and the Bulgarians cut it with a surprise attack by the strasti east of Sredets, so that only the leading elements of the main body reached the pass. In 969 Nikephoros II Phokas still tried the method of pushing dense infantry straight ahead, but he was caught in a mountain defile where the grass was burned to deny the horses fodder and where cavalry harried him again and again, and he turned back. The real turning point was Tzimiskes. What he took from the Arabs and the Bulgarians was to put light skirmishers and archers in front of the great army as a screen, wearing out the enemy's edge step by step, keeping the heavy infantry motionless in the centre, showing the cavalry only on the wings and on the enemy's flank, and letting the guard fall on in one wave only after the enemy had disordered itself in a frontal assault; the chronicles describe exactly this rhythm at the gates of Sredets, and after that single battle Bulgaria had no field army left in the southern plain. The Bulgarian method was to hold the difficult ground and wait for help: the country between the Danube and Sredets was their shield, and the narrow passes, the deep valleys and gates like the Iron Gates broke up Byzantine columns by themselves; the ambush in the defile in 968, the burning of the grass to cut the enemy's fodder in 969, and the interception of the Byzantine detachment by light troops at Kleidion in 970 were all the same method. In 971 Samuel refused to give battle in the open again and retired to the fortress of Vit near Bitola, blocking the approaches with wooden fences and thrown stones, which was his last way of dragging the war out into a siege.
data: 有根據可寫的數字大致如下。968年首批拜占庭遠征軍的兵力，狄奧菲拉托斯·西莫卡塔說遠征軍總數在一萬以上，另有記為步兵萬餘、騎兵數千；此役全軍覆沒，尼基弗魯斯被俘、巴爾達斯被弄瞎雙眼，交戰地點在斯雷代茨東的鐵門一帶狹谷。969年尼基弗魯斯二世御駕再攻，兵力當在數萬之數，先後攻下普雷斯拉夫等要塞，卻在山谷受阻，冬季缺糧。969年12月11日他病逝，12月16日齊米斯基斯即位。970年8月27日斯雷代茨之戰是全役的轉折點；同年10月26日克萊迪翁之戰，拜占庭分遣隊據記載約八千人被保加利亞輕兵全滅，這是帝國在巴爾干罕有的大敗。971年齊米斯基斯再舉兵，兵數史料從一萬餘到數萬不等，北方傭兵與重裝步兵為主力，四月沿斯特魯馬河谷北上，攻佔斯科普里，秋季進抵比托拉，10月薩穆伊爾在維特堡壘投降。972年10月薩穆伊爾反叛被平定，976年被自己人刺殺，兩個兒子被弄瞎送往君士坦丁堡。距離方面，君士坦丁堡至斯雷代茨約一千二百公里，971年那一線沿河谷推進約三百公里。保加利亞控制的土地約二十五萬平方公里，希臘史料常以十萬形容其全國兵員，實際投入野戰的兵力在數萬之數；拜占庭在多瑙河以南的領土與人口都遠在其上，卻要靠僱傭兵而非稅收支撐這場遠征。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. On the strength of the first Byzantine expedition of 968, Theophylact Simocatta gives the size of the army as more than ten thousand in all, and elsewhere as some ten thousand foot and several thousand horse; the army was destroyed entire, Nikephoros was taken prisoner, Bardas had his eyes put out, and the fighting took place in a defile near the Iron Gates east of Sredets. In 969 Nikephoros II Phokas campaigned in person with what must have been tens of thousands, took fortresses including Preslav, and was then held up in the mountains, short of food in the winter. He died on 11 December 969 and Tzimiskes was acclaimed on 16 December. The battle at Sredets on 27 August 970 was the turning point of the whole war; and at the battle of Kleidion on 26 October of the same year a Byzantine detachment, recorded at about eight thousand men, was annihilated by Bulgarian light troops, one of the rare great defeats the empire suffered in the Balkans. In 971 Tzimiskes took the field again, the strength of the army being given anywhere from ten-odd thousand to tens of thousands, with northern mercenaries and heavy infantry as the core; in April it moved up the valley of the Struma, took Skopje, reached Bitola in the autumn, and in October Samuel surrendered at the fortress of Vit. Samuel's rising was put down in October 972; he was killed by his own men in 976, and his two sons were blinded and sent to Constantinople. As for distance, it is about twelve hundred kilometres from Constantinople to Sredets, and the axis of the campaign of 971 ran some three hundred kilometres up the valley. The ground Bulgaria controlled was of the order of two hundred and fifty thousand square kilometres; Greek sources habitually speak of a hundred thousand men under arms for the whole country, while the force actually brought to the field was in the tens of thousands. The Byzantine territories and population south of the Danube were far larger than Bulgaria's, and yet it was mercenaries rather than the revenue of the tax registers that paid for the expedition.
cause: 打起來有近因，也有遠因。近因是公元968年拜占庭與保加利亞關係的驟然破裂：希臘史料記載保加利亞使節在君士坦丁堡受到凌辱，彼得一世停止納貢、襲擊馬其頓與色雷斯的軍區地界，殺害拜占庭在都拉齊烏姆一帶的守官，兩國的邊境衝突從零星劫掠升級為全面進攻；拜占庭朝廷把這些事當作羞辱與叛盟，決定用一次成功的軍事行動把保加利亞壓回去。遠因是彼得一世治下保加利亞的國勢已到頂峰：它控制著馬其頓、塞薩洛尼基周邊與多瑙河下游的交通與關稅，收南斯拉夫諸部族的貢賦，並支持匈牙利大公居魯姆的改宗與反叛，使君士坦丁堡在後方與西北方同時感到威脅。更深一層，這是拜占庭自身權力結構的必然產物：庫爾庫阿斯在968年病死，他靠十年邊境戰爭建立起來的權威與皇帝共治的默契一併消失，福卡斯家族上臺，必須靠一場乾淨利落的勝利證明自己的正統；而帝國的財政在多年阿拉伯戰役與邊軍開銷之後已經吃緊，戰爭的規模既不能太大也不能拖得太久，這個計算決定了拜占庭先試探、再傾力出擊，最後必須由齊米斯基斯用一場會戰把戰爭收掉。
causeEn: There was both a proximate cause and a distant one. The proximate cause was the sudden rupture between Byzantium and Bulgaria in 968: the Greek sources record that Bulgarian envoys were treated with contempt at Constantinople, that Peter I stopped paying tribute and struck at the lands of the military districts of Macedonia and Thrace, and that the Byzantine commander at Durrës was killed, so that border skirmishing between the two states turned into open war. The Byzantine court treated all of this as an insult and a breach of faith, and resolved to beat Bulgaria back in a single successful campaign. The distant cause was that the Bulgarian state under Peter I had reached the height of its power: it held the lines of communication and the customs of Macedonia, the neighbourhood of Thessalonica and the lower Danube, it drew tribute from the South Slav peoples, and it backed the conversion and the revolt of the Hungarian duke Gyula, so that Constantinople felt threatened both behind and to the north-west. At a deeper level the war was the inevitable product of Byzantium's own structure of power. When Kourkouas died in 968, the authority he had built over ten years of frontier war and the working arrangement of co-rule with the emperor vanished together; the Phokas family came to the palace and had to prove its legitimacy with a clean and complete victory. And the finances of the empire, worn down by years of Arab campaigns and frontier expenditure, could not bear a war that was either very large or very long. That calculation is what made Byzantium probe first, then commit in force, and finally required Tzimiskes to end the war with a single battle.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果是保加利亞國家的解體與重組。政治上，獨立的保加利亞帝國從此不再存在：普雷斯拉夫與普利斯卡的帝都功能被取消，原有的軍區被改編為拜占庭的行政單位保加利亞軍區，各地要隘由拜占庭將領與駐軍接管，佩切尼格與保加爾貴族的土地被重新分配給軍功顯赫者與北方來客，保加利亞的公爵與貴族階層就此消散。教會上同樣是斷裂：普雷斯拉夫宗主教區在972年被降格為隸屬君士坦丁堡牧區的主教區，字母學校與保加爾文獻中心被關閉，教堂的聖像被帶走或被拜占庭風格的裝飾覆蓋，鮑里斯時期累積的教會自治傳統戛然而止。南斯拉夫地區因此被整齊地併入拜占庭的行政與教會體系，構成了後來保加利亞軍區與馬其頓軍區的骨架，也把今日塞爾維亞、保加利亞與北馬其頓的宗教歸屬長期推向東羅馬一側。軍事的成果更為長久：齊米斯基斯在這幾年裡完成了一次帝國軍制的整頓——散兵前哨、混合兵種、帝國近衛作為預備隊投入——這套體制寫進十世紀的拜占庭戰術手冊，成為後來曼齊刻爾特與貝拉西察等戰役的底子；瓦良格人也在這一戰中從北方傭兵正式轉為帝國近衛的骨幹，東歐人口第一次大規模流入拜占庭的莊園體系。而保加利亞民族並未消失，它只是從帝國降為被征服的對象，四十餘年後薩穆伊爾在貝拉西察重整旗鼓，仍以敗亡收場——這場戰爭開啟了長達半個世紀的被支配年代，也埋下了百年後阿森與彼得起義的種子。
impactEn: The outcome of this war was the dissolution and reconstruction of the Bulgarian state. Politically the independent Bulgarian Empire ceased to exist: the imperial functions of Preslav and Pliska were abolished, the old military districts were reorganised into the Byzantine administrative unit of the theme of Bulgaria, the strategic passes were taken over by Byzantine officers and garrisons, and the lands of the Pecheneg and Bulgarian nobles were redistributed to men of proved service and to newcomers from the north, so that the class of Bulgarian dukes and magnates simply disappeared. Ecclesiastically the break was just as sharp: the archbishopric of Preslav was reduced in 972 to a bishopric subject to the patriarchate of Constantinople, the school of letters and the centre of Bulgarian letters were closed down, the icons of the churches were carried off or covered over with Byzantine decoration, and the tradition of church autonomy built up in the time of Boris came to an abrupt end. The South Slav lands were thus drawn neatly into the administrative and ecclesiastical system of Byzantium, forming the skeleton of the later themes of Bulgaria and Macedonia, and permanently pushing the religious allegiance of what are now Serbia, Bulgaria and northern Macedonia towards the eastern Romans. The military results lasted longer still. In these years Tzimiskes completed a reform of the imperial army — skirmishers in front, mixed arms, the imperial guard committed as a reserve — and that system went into the tenth-century Byzantine tactical manuals, becoming the foundation of later battles such as those of Manzikert and Belasitsa. In this war the Varangians also turned for good from northern mercenaries into the backbone of the imperial guard, and East European population entered the Byzantine estate system on a large scale for the first time. The Bulgarian people, meanwhile, did not disappear; they were simply reduced from an empire to a conquered subject, and some forty years later Samuel raised his banner once more at Belasitsa and still met with defeat. This war opened a domination lasting half a century, and it also planted the seed of the rising of Asen and Peter a century later.
result: 公元971年10月，保加利亞的抵抗在比托拉附近的維特堡壘前終止。薩穆伊爾在援軍斷絕、糧道被封、攻城的投石機已經砸壞外牆的況況下同意停戰，與兩個兒子一同被帶往君士坦丁堡；齊米斯基斯把薩穆伊爾的兩個兒子立為共治皇帝，保加利亞則在形式上作為拜占庭的一個軍區繼續存在。隨後的收尾更為冷酷：公元972年10月薩穆伊爾趁拜占庭主力東調時反叛，被平定，公元976年他被自己的侍從刺殺，兩個兒子被弄瞎雙眼送往君士坦丁堡，鮑里斯王公的名號在保加利亞被徹底抹去。從968年8月的全軍覆沒到971年10月的投降，拜占庭用三年、兩位皇帝、數萬兵馬與一次慘敗換來了巴爾干半壁：保加利亞的城邑被拆毀或收編，約二十餘處要塞被拜占庭駐軍接管，直到1185年阿森與彼得起義時，這個軍區才重新脫離帝國。得與失都要記清楚：拜占庭贏得了安全，卻沒有贏得人心，征服並未消滅保加利亞的國家記憶，薩穆伊爾的傳說在民間流傳了幾百年，之後每一次保加利亞人的反叛，都會以這一段歷史作為旗幟。
resultEn: In October 971 the Bulgarian resistance ended before the fortress of Vit near Bitola. With no help coming, his grain road sealed and the besiegers' stone-throwers already battering the outer wall, Samuel agreed to terms and was taken to Constantinople together with his two sons. Tzimiskes made the two boys co-emperors, and Bulgaria continued to exist in form as a theme of the Byzantine state. The epilogue was colder than the settlement: in October 972 Samuel rose in revolt while the Byzantine main force was drawn off eastward, and the rising was put down; in 976 he was killed by his own servants, and his two sons were blinded and sent to Constantinople, and the name of the Boris dynasty was wiped out in Bulgaria. From the destruction of the army in August 968 to the surrender in October 971, Byzantium had bought half the Balkans with three years, two emperors, tens of thousands of men and one catastrophic defeat: the towns of Bulgaria were dismantled or absorbed, something like twenty fortresses passed to Byzantine garrisons, and it was only with the rising of Asen and Peter in 1185 that this theme broke free of the empire again. Both the gain and the loss have to be set down: Byzantium won security but not hearts, and the conquest did not erase the memory of the Bulgarian state; the legend of Samuel was carried in the countryside for centuries afterwards, and every later rising of the Bulgarians raised that stretch of history as its banner.
